sections.title: Natural Reflexive Processes
sections.content: Hungarian often expresses processes happening without an overt human agent using *-ódik / -ődik*: *készül* ('is being made'), *megoldódik* ('resolves itself / gets solved'), *átalakul* ('transforms'), *kifejlődik* ('develops').

items.spanish: A probléma magától megoldódott, amint újraindították a gépet.
items.english: The problem resolved itself as soon as the machine was restarted.

items.spanish: A rendszerben minden adat automatikusan frissül.
items.english: In the system, all data is updated automatically.
